units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 19:12">Gen. R. s. 19</cite> (play on <he>עֲלֵי תאנה</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 3:7">Gen. III, 7</cite>) <he>ע׳ שהביאו תואנה וכ׳</he> the leaves which brought grief into the world; Yalk. ib. 27 <he>ע׳ שהביא וכ׳</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 7:1">Shebi. VII, 1</cite> <he>עֲלֵה הלוף השוטה</he>, v. <cite ref="L00302"><he>לוֹף</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="P00808"><he>עָלִים</he></cite>, <he>עָלִין</he>; constr. <cite ref="P00791"><he>עֲלֵי</he></cite>. Y. ib. V, 35ᵈ bot. <he>מהוצאת ע׳ ועד וכ׳</he> from the sprouting of leaves to the coming forth of buds of fruits there is an interval of fifty days. Ib. <he>עלי בצלים</he> leaves of onions.
<cite ref="Chullin 92a:19">Ḥull. 92ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ שבה וכ׳</he> the leaves thereon (on the vine Israel) are the untutored, v. <cite ref="A03305"><he>אֶשְׁכּוֹל</he></cite>; a. fr.
